The '''Cybernetic Weapon Enhancement Mod VII''' was a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] weapon implant available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Designed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], the Mod VII was the seventh&ndash;and first successful&ndash;attempt made by the company to create a realistic [[Limb/Legends|limb]] that also functioned as a long-range weapon.<ref name="EOTEC" /> The enhancement cost 4000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and was made using outsourced limb components combined with BlasTech's own design of light [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. The device looked and functioned like a normal limb most of the [[Time/Legends|time]], but could split open to reveal the weapon component at a speed quick enough to surprise most opponents. The weapon was favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and could not be dropped or removed.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cybernetic Weapon Enhancement Mod VII was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
